reviews.review:
OKAY
IT'S A RANT

I don't like Warframe, and neither should you imho.
Question - should you play Warframe? 
If you want to play it seriously and achieve something within while not spending a lot of money or time, then a resounding No.
Warframe doesn't like you. It never will. And you shouldn't like it either.
Does it look nice? Yeah, totally!
But there's so many bad things to say about the game I dunno where to begin.

1. It's hella outdated. The game *is* being updated, but the content that's been in the game since 2013 is still unchanged and I'm talking LEVEL DESIGN, ENEMIES, BOSSES, WEAPONS, PARKOUR, MINI-GAMES, "STEALTH" that's been the first marketing tool that now doesn't matter at all. How can you update the game with all that lore and still pretty much abandon the early content? 
And that's only the entry-level stuff we're talking about. Next stop is

2. It's buggy AF. It just is as clunky as it is buggy. Parkour is crappy, non-fluid and weird all around, the interface is buggy, the lobby is buggy, and those bugs are not the end of the world, but every once in a while it's really easy to feel your eye twitching.
I didn't know where to begin, but I know where to end the rant part.

3. IT'S PREDATORY MONETISATION. Hell naw, you gotta make me farm for 50 rocks so I send them to the forge for 12 real life hours? And I have to do it 3 times? AND THEN I GOTTA SPEND 3 DAYS??? JUST TO GET A NEW CHARACTER??? BUT I CAN USE REAL LIFE MONEY TO SPEED THE PROCESS UP? (and your character space is limited but CaN bE eXpAnDeD wItH rEaL mOnEy oHhHh YeAhHhH)
I know that it is a free game with a lot of free content but man you can tone the predatory monetisation down just a bit, can you not? 
Or, better yet, you farm for a relic that has a slim chance (best rates are around 20% to get exactly what you need) of giving you the part of the thing you want? And then you farm some other 5 or so different relics? And then the odds are against you and you got NOTHING while spending around 4-5 hours of your life?
And that is literally THE TIP OF THE ICEBERG.

You know, a lot of people say that Warframe is good, interesting yadda yadda yadda. Sometimes it actually is. Hats off to some guys doing the plot - I don't get a single part of it, but it looks cool and outstanding. Same goes for visual designers crew.
But mostly you just do meaningless tasks to then change a character and do the same things over and over again.
That's a game for people with either some spare money they can invest in the game, or with approximately 30 hours of free time per day.
That artistic representation and universe deserves better then blind to the relevant issues, hungry-for-money bosses.

You may ask - why bother collecting warframes, weapons, etc., if you can play the game free without all that?
The response is - the gameplay is so shallow that it turns the brain off. This is a game about crunching numbers on paper, not outplaying your enemies with a display of prowess and skill. It just isn't. There's no skill to this game, only math and randomness. Therefore, no being able to dive into the game, you will try to enjoy the vastness of it. The vastness of seemingly different guns, all fulfilling a single role, the formiddable numbers of Warframes, which do not matter in the slightest. 
This is a game that tricks you into collecting stuff, and then makes collecting stuff painful. It is addictive because you always get some new stuff, but it still isn't enough. Like a drug, per say.

I hope that I persuade at the very least a single person to not do this. 
My advise - play it for a couple of weekdays and leave it like you prolly did with a lot of other f2p projects.
Take care.

I've been playing this game for years, mostly on Xbox. The game has so many ways to play and the game is constantly being updated in regular patches. It can be hard to get into for newer players without a mentor.

This game is deep and massive, if you like looter shooters this is the one to play. Story can be either vague to the point of non existence to a real tear jerker depending on where you are in the game. Be prepared to grind a lot. One of the best free games available.
